# Machine Politics

> Where every country stands on autonomous weapons: recorded votes, official statements, and national policy, tracked as they shift over time. Every position links to a quoted, dated source.

The site takes no position on whether autonomous weapons should be banned or regulated. It records who says what.

- [Board](https://machinepolitics.walker-robinson.com/)
- [Conference](https://machinepolitics.walker-robinson.com/conference.html)

- State pages: https://machinepolitics.walker-robinson.com/state/ISO3.html (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code, for example USA)
